# Marimo Studio 0.2.0

Marimo Studio 0.2.0 updates its Marimo integration to 0.25 and makes standalone
browser previews the path for agents to inspect custom views.

## Browser-native view inspection

- `View.preview_url(runtime="server")` and `marimo-studio view preview` return
  a standalone URL that browser tools can open, interact with, and inspect.
- Agents that used Studio-mediated browser validation should open the returned
  URL and inspect the rendered view through their browser tool.
- Stable preview URLs follow successful publications. A revision-specific URL
  returns HTTP 409 when its requested revision is no longer current.

## Provider-owned view dependencies

- Custom views that use UnoCSS, Iconify, HTMX, or other browser libraries load
  them from their provider project. The Vanilla starter includes pinned
  UnoCSS and Iconify assets.
- `view_root` stores view projects in a directory selected by the notebook's
  configuration, including directories that a host application persists.
- Studio preserves host scripts in the outer page and validates configured
  `data-parent-origin` values against its framing policy.

## Authoring and preview updates

- Python previews refresh after notebook cells are edited and run through code
  mode, and standalone previews catch up after publication or reconnection.
- Native controls and Markdown follow each view's projection variables across
  Server, Browser, and Prepared runtimes.
- Sandboxed notebooks load Studio and the server's Deno runtime for framework
  view creation and builds.
- The guides add a quadratic programs example that uses one notebook for a
  Reveal.js lecture, an HTML explainer, and a Svelte and D3 lab.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.2.0 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and Marimo 0.25.0. The
`deno` extra provides Deno 2.9.5 or newer for React, Reveal.js, Svelte, and
Notebook Kit authoring. The `lens` extra requires marimo-lens 0.2.2 or newer.

[All changes since 0.1.6](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.1.6...v0.2.0)
